planets.name: K2-182 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-182 with a 4.74-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-182 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-182. Its orbit and size follow Thygesen et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
